resources.string: Off by default · trusted local profiles

Automatic login for configured native apps: exact app signature, sender, service and account matching. No per-login confirmation. Missing identity, permission or verified success stays manual. Native text observation resumes after verification; images remain local during this run.
Permission or save failed. Keep manual login; check Android app permissions.

Enable automatic SMS login only for accounts and signed apps you configure here. Mika may request, fill and submit login without asking again, then verify the account locally. No payment, recovery or registration. SMS and codes are never saved or sent to the model. Disable or delete a profile to revoke.
Automatically requesting, filling and verifying the configured account. Cancel stops this attempt.

Configure once. Save authorizes automatic code request, account/code entry, final login and account verification for this signed app. Mapping requires reviewed native resource IDs and a unique logged-in account indicator. One account per app; edit or delete to revoke. Stored locally with Android Keystore encryption.
